name: claude-cpp
description: Write instructions for Claude Code as C++ or Python that compiles into a prompt. Learn a language by using it as your interface to your AI assistant.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: Compiling and running instructions.cpp / instructions.py executes code, so it is disabled in untrusted workspaces.

commands.title: Reset claude.hpp / claude.py to Bundled Version

claudeCpp.autoOpen.description: Open the instructions file and the Claude panel whenever a folder is opened.

claudeCpp.compileOnSave.description: Recompile instructions.cpp every time it is saved.

claudeCpp.compiler.description: C++ compiler used to build instructions.cpp.

claudeCpp.cppStandard.description: Value passed to the compiler as -std=<value>.

claudeCpp.extraCompilerFlags.description: Extra flags passed to the compiler.

claudeCpp.python.description: Python interpreter used to run instructions.py (command name or full path).

claudeCpp.claudePath.description: Path to the Claude Code CLI. Leave empty to auto-detect (~/.local/bin/claude, Homebrew, or your login shell's PATH).

claudeCpp.permissionMode.description: Claude Code permission mode for prompts sent from this panel. The panel is non-interactive, so anything not permitted is denied. 'bypassPermissions' lets Claude run any tool without asking.

claudeCpp.allowedTools.description: Extra tools to pre-approve, e.g. "Bash(git status)" or "Bash(npm test)".

claudeCpp.model.description: Model alias or name passed to Claude Code (--model). Leave empty for the default.
